title: Fabric MAAP engine deviates from IEEE 1722-2016 Annex B (multicast DEFEND, timing constants, ANNOUNCE conflict)
body:
[A10] Found by #665 lane F2 (A558, STOP 6026825549) while comparing against the standard. The parent's fabric MAAP engine (`hdl/ieee1722/maap/KL_maap.sv`) differs from IEEE 1722-2016 Annex B:
- **DEFEND destination and length.** `:197`/`:203` sends DEFEND to the MAAP multicast address with length 28. B.2.1 sends DEFEND to the source MAC of the triggering PROBE.
- **Timing constants.** `:102`/`:138` uses a 3-second announcement base and 500 to 627 ms probe draws. Check them against B.3.3/Table B.8 and B.3.4.
- **ANNOUNCE conflict.** `:324` checks ANNOUNCE conflict fields; check against B.3.2/Table B.7.
- **Tests.** Existing tests pin some of these behaviours (`tb/verilator/maap/sim_main.cpp:148`, `:207`).

The all-fabric build ships this engine, so it is a conformance defect in the shipping default.

**Acceptance:**
1. Each item is either conformed to Annex B or justified by clause.
2. The tests are re-pointed to the standard, each with a planted control.
3. OOC area is within 40 LUT / 40 FF.
4. Interop: the MAAP exchange with the reference peer is unchanged on the bench.

Relates to #665 (F2 compares against the standard, not this engine).
